note: v3 registration file. The v2 thresholds were split between configs/g0_prime.json (eight items) and in-code constants (T9, etc.), so 'pre-run registration in configs' no longer holds (review B5). This file is the sole source of thresholds; the code reads it at runtime, and a missing value causes a hard failure.

negative_controls.note: r4 = Z_eff*n_B must deviate by exactly a factor of m_bar=10. If this value ever becomes 1.0, it means the regression guard has failed, not that the error was fixed.

capture_convention: kinetic (excludes m_e); total-mu convention adds 0.511 MeV

test_registry.IDENT: definitional identity; reported for traceability, NOT counted as correctness evidence
test_registry.CHECK: genuinely independent computation; counted as correctness evidence
test_registry.NEGCTRL: must-fail control; passing means the guard actually detects the known error

nu_budget_frac.label: registered energy-budget placeholder
nu_budget_frac.reason: 0.75 is the 3D UR coefficient; the 2D value is 2/3. Ratio 1.125 printed explicitly. Real neutrino transport deferred to R1-B3.
